{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries IPC label, adds `src/interfaces/snapshot.h`, and exposes snapshot loading and progress notifications on `interfaces::Node`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Exposes UTXO snapshot loading and progress updates across the interface boundary, directly unblocking companion GUI assumeutxo implementations in bitcoin-core/gui#870 and bitcoin-core/gui-qml#488."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/kernel/notifications_interface.h` and `src/node/kernel_notifications.{h,cpp}` to add snapshot progress callback support.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends the kernel notifications interface boundary to route progress reporting during snapshot loading out of validation."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches validation only for snapshot progress reporting; does not touch mempool structures, validation rules, or relay policy.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "None."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Refactors `loadtxoutset` in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` to use the new snapshot interface and changes error codes.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Consuming the interface in `loadtxoutset` provides test coverage for the abstraction, but alters returned error codes on file-opening and parsing failures from RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER/RPC_DESERIALIZATION_ERROR to RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in `src/validation.cpp` are limited to firing a progress notification hook during snapshot population.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Emitting progress notifications does not substantively alter consensus rules, validation logic, or chainstate invariants."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}

categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Carries IPC label, adds `src/interfaces/snapshot.h`, and exposes snapshot loading and progress notifications on `interfaces::Node`.
categories.rationale: Exposes UTXO snapshot loading and progress updates across the interface boundary, directly unblocking companion GUI assumeutxo implementations in bitcoin-core/gui#870 and bitcoin-core/gui-qml#488.

categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Touches `src/kernel/notifications_interface.h` and `src/node/kernel_notifications.{h,cpp}` to add snapshot progress callback support.
categories.rationale: Extends the kernel notifications interface boundary to route progress reporting during snapshot loading out of validation.

categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Touches validation only for snapshot progress reporting; does not touch mempool structures, validation rules, or relay policy.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Refactors `loadtxoutset` in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` to use the new snapshot interface and changes error codes.
categories.rationale: Consuming the interface in `loadtxoutset` provides test coverage for the abstraction, but alters returned error codes on file-opening and parsing failures from RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER/RPC_DESERIALIZATION_ERROR to RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Changes in `src/validation.cpp` are limited to firing a progress notification hook during snapshot population.
categories.rationale: Emitting progress notifications does not substantively alter consensus rules, validation logic, or chainstate invariants.
